maria: Auditor (Jane) pinged about SOC2 sample for incident INC-2025-042. They want a playback of the RBAC change + KMS key rotation timeline + correlated audit logs for the 30-min window. Can ops pull artifacts? (we need a manifest with hashes/s3 links)

sam: What's the exact sample window they need? 30m around the incident? Also do they need decrypted keys or just key IDs and KMS audit events?

 audito r_jane: 1) 30 minutes centered on the incident time is fine. 2) We don't need plaintext keys. We want: KMS Audit Events (Encrypt/Decrypt/GenerateDataKey/Sign), key IDs, rotation events with timestamps, and any service-account role changes. 3) Prefer JSONL with splunk/elk query outputs + a signed manifest (sha256) and S3 presigned URLs.

 sam: OK that's clear. Is there a required schema for the audit events (fields we must include)?

 auditor_jane: Minimal required fields: timestamp, user, action, resource, request_id, raw_event. JSONL each line. We may ask for additional context if we see anomalies.

 maria: OK. Plan: 1) Splunk query for authz & kms events; 2) KMS rotation log from cloud provider; 3) RBAC change events from IAM (roleBinding changes) + who approved; 4) mapping doc (control ID -> artifact). I'll produce S3 presigned links and a sha256 manifest. Any format constraints for the manifest?

 auditor_jane: Manifest should list files, sha256, time generated, contact person. A single top-level mapping file named evidence-manifest.jsonl is preferred. Also include a short README.md describing provenance. Signed with our internal GPG OK but not required. Chain of custody note: include who uploaded and which S3 bucket.

 raj: For RBAC events we only keep full diffs for 180 days. For the 30-min window we can provide full audit logs. Splunk team: use query below and include request_ids to correlate.

 sam: Dropping initial splunk query — will run in limited window and sanitize PII.

```
index=redwood-audit "roleBinding" OR "iam" OR "KMS" earliest=1812223274 latest=1812223474 | sort 0 _time | table _time, user, action, resource, request_id, details
```

 ops-bot: Automated export started: export_id=exp-20260323-91, ETA ~12m. Will upload to s3://redwood-audit-evidence/auditor-1812223334/

 olivia: FYI: need approvals from security leadership for external auditor access to S3. cc @maria @sam. I'll start the approval ticket.

 maria: Thanks. I'll prepare the manifest and mapping doc, include key fingerprints and rotation proof (KMS key metadata), and update here when upload complete. :+1: 

 ops-bot: Export complete: exp-20260323-91 uploaded 5 files. presigned_urls_sent_to=auditor_jane@externaldomain.com. manifest location: s3://redwood-audit-evidence/auditor-1812223334/evidence-manifest.jsonl

 auditor_jane: Received links — will validate checksums and revert if anything missing. Thx."
